title: XTRIME – Lime Paradise
description:
🍈 Extreme Lime Paradise 🏝️ is an amazing line of Extreme nicotine pouches that gives you a fantastic feeling .

Delicate lime 🍋 gives a sweet taste to the product and creates a refreshing aftertaste .

It provides your breath with a pleasant aroma 🌬️ for the whole day .

EXTREME LIME PARADISE – incredible exotic available to everyone 🌴🍈

Portion size: 0,8g
Nicotine: 16mg/1gram
Nicotine per portion: 12,8mg
Portions in one package: 20 pc
